mapper.select: SELECT d.status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM eqp_device d WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.status

SELECT r.device_id, d.code AS device_code, d.name AS device_name, COUNT(*) AS repair_count FROM eqp_repair r INNER JOIN eqp_device d ON d.id = r.device_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.report_time >= #{monthStart} GROUP BY r.device_id, d.code, d.name ORDER BY repair_count DESC, r.device_id LIMIT 5
